messages:
Ana (Partnerships): heads up — for the EU roadshow next month we need a tighter micro-pod demo rotation and customs plan for partner swag. who can take point on the shipping HS codes + local courier? :package:
Mike (Events Ops): I can own the rotation schedule. want 2x 20min demos per booth + 10min handover. need speaker names & SLAs by EOD Wed. :calendar:
Li (Logistics): i can do couriers but need full packing list + declared values. customs flagged last time for batteries inside demo kits. do any kits include spare batteries?
Jordan - AcmeHW: our demo laptops have internal batteries only, no spares. we do have a small accessory puck (battery-backed) — i'll flag it and provide an HS code.
Ana (Partnerships): @Jordan — please drop the HS code and exact weight per kit. also need a photo of the packing box for security checks.
Jordan - AcmeHW: HS code: 85076000. weight per kit 4.2kg. packing photo: https://acme.example.com/roadshow/kit-photo.jpg
Li (Logistics): perfect. also need SKU list in this format so we can generate manifest:
```
- sku: ACME-LL-01
  desc: demo-laptop-with-puck
  qty: 6
  declared_value_eur: 1200
```
Sara (Marketing): for swag customs — do we have country-specific rules for stickers vs apparel? some EU countries want textile declarations. checklist pls. :tshirt:
Li (Logistics): yes — apparel needs fiber content + country of origin. stickers are fine. i'll add a column to the manifest template.
Mike (Events Ops): rotation note: two demo pods per booth -> Pod A starts 10:00, Pod B 10:20, repeat. need volunteer rotation sheet for 6 booth-hours. i'll prep and share later today.
Ana (Partnerships): fallback plan if AcmeHW kit delayed — we should have a cloud-only demo bundle that runs on hosted API. Jordan, can you supply a sanitized docker image or runbook?
Jordan - AcmeHW: can provide a container image (no proprietary keys) and a simplified dataset. will post link to SHA and minimal runbook by tomorrow.
OpsBot: Reminder: book courier by 1797720000 to hit customs cutoff for Tuesday arrival.
Li (Logistics): booking window noted. also raising customs bond option for one larger shipment to speed clearance. cost ~€150, approve?
Sara (Marketing): approve on marketing side. prefer bonded shipment to avoid demos stuck at port.
Ana (Partnerships): approve. Mike, can you update the run-of-show to show bonded shipment arrival & handoff at load-in desk?
Mike (Events Ops): will update run-of-show and tag load-in volunteers. sharing draft in #events in ~2h.
Ana (Partnerships): final deliverables checklist from this thread:
- Jordan: HS code + packing photo + container/runbook link (tomorrow)
- Li: manifest template with apparel fiber + bonded shipment booking (by EOD)
- Mike: rotation spreadsheet + run-of-show update (today)
- Sara: swag customs declarations + labels for apparel (EOD)
Please mark done in this thread. :white_check_mark:
Li (Logistics): noted, will post manifest template in channel when ready.
Jordan - AcmeHW: will drop links + SHA in channel tomorrow AM.
Mike (Events Ops): draft rotation posted in #events at 14:30 — tagging @Ana for review.
Ana (Partnerships): thanks team — small ask: can someone send a single PDF packing list we can attach to partner invoices? saves finance followups.
Li (Logistics): will generate a single PDF after manifest is final and upload to shared drive. link will be here.
Sara (Marketing): i'll prepare the on-site sticker sheet and print-ready labels once Li confirms fiber content column.
Ana (Partnerships): awesome. closing loop — if anything slips, call out immediately in this thread and @Ana. :phone:
OpsBot: Shipping cutoff alert set for 1797716400 (local warehouse).
